title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit: Tier Entry Requirements and Credit Limit Ranges
content:
Each of the six tiers of FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit has its own entry requirements, measured at application, and its own range of credit limits.

## Grid

| Tier | Minimum FICO Score 8 | Maximum debt-to-income | Minimum verified gross annual income (USD) | Lowest credit limit (USD) | Highest credit limit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FlexLine Starter | 600 | 45% | 25000 | 1000 | 2500 |
| FlexLine Standard | 640 | 45% | 30000 | 2500 | 5000 |
| FlexLine Plus | 670 | 40% | 40000 | 5000 | 10000 |
| FlexLine Preferred | 700 | 40% | 50000 | 7500 | 15000 |
| FlexLine Premier | 730 | 36% | 65000 | 10000 | 25000 |
| FlexLine Elite | 760 | 36% | 85000 | 15000 | 35000 |

## What each column means

- **Minimum FICO Score 8**: Minimum FICO Score 8 at application (integer).
- **Maximum debt-to-income**: Maximum debt-to-income ratio at application, counting a payment of 3% of the credit limit, percent.
- **Minimum income**: Minimum verified gross annual income, USD.
- **Lowest credit limit**: Lowest credit limit in the tier, USD; also the floor for a requested decrease.
- **Highest credit limit**: Highest credit limit in the tier, USD; also the ceiling for any increase.

The first three columns are the tier's entry requirements; the last two bound the credit limits a line in that tier can carry.

## Reading the grid

**Does a figure exactly at the requirement meet it?** Yes. A minimum is met by a figure equal to it and a maximum is met by a figure equal to it: a FICO Score 8 of exactly 670 meets the FlexLine Plus minimum, and a debt-to-income ratio of exactly 40% meets the FlexLine Plus maximum.

**Hypothetical illustration.** An applicant with a FICO Score 8 of 712, a debt-to-income ratio of 38% and verified income of 55000 USD meets the entry requirements of FlexLine Starter, FlexLine Standard, FlexLine Plus and FlexLine Preferred, and does not meet those of FlexLine Premier (score below 730) or FlexLine Elite (score below 760). These inputs are chosen for illustration only.

**Do the limit ranges overlap?** Yes. Neighbouring tiers share boundary figures (FlexLine Standard's lowest limit, 2500 USD, is FlexLine Starter's highest), and FlexLine Preferred, FlexLine Premier and FlexLine Elite ranges overlap in part. Each line's limit is always read against its own tier's row.
